key_regulations: Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act

enrichments.summary: NOVACAB SAPI de CV is recalling Suspiros German Cake products (15P and 4P sizes) because they contain goat milk that was mislabeled as 'milk', posing an undeclared allergen risk.
NOVACAB SAPI de CV has recalled multiple Suspiros Tres Leches Cajeta Cake products because they contain goat milk that was only labeled as 'milk', posing an undeclared allergen risk.

NOVACAB SAPI de CV is recalling Suspiros Cheese Cake Coyota products because they contain goat milk that was not properly declared on the label and was instead listed as 'milk', posing a risk to individuals sensitive to goat milk.
NOVACAB SAPI de CV is recalling multiple Suspiros 4 Leches Cake products due to undeclared goat milk, which was labeled only as 'milk' on the packaging.
NOVACAB SAPI de CV is recalling Suspiros Choconut Cake products because they contain undeclared goat milk, which was incorrectly labeled as 'milk' on the packaging.

Multiple cake products, including Cajeta cupcakes, are being recalled because they contain undeclared goat milk. The ingredient was labeled as 'milk' instead of 'goat milk,' posing a risk to consumers with goat milk allergies.

NOVACAB SAPI de CV is recalling 'Suspiros Cajeta Cake' products due to undeclared goat milk. The product was labeled as containing 'milk' but did not specify 'goat milk', posing an allergen risk to consumers sensitive to goat milk.

NOVACAB SAPI de CV is recalling Suspiros Mazapan Cake products because they contain goat milk, which was only labeled as 'milk' on the packaging. This mislabeling could pose a risk to individuals with specific goat milk allergies or sensitivities.
